title: Inquiry Hearing
warm:

Testimony did not force any of them.

Unused perfume memory on [player_name]'s pulse. Marcus Pell sat ready with traveling language. Rhea Quinn's slate lived in a folder nearby.

[player_name] did not invent a corpse by testifying. She did not invent Milan. Inquiry only proved soft could be sworn for or against—and that Vivienne's cadence could still be method or coincidence depending on which fear she fed. Soft meant pliable evidence under oath pressure.

"Stand fully as cover with Nolan at your back," she heard the choice cataloguing itself, "or name one fate thread without locking Layer 10. Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend the swear."
